results.content:
On the downside, setup takes patience: HTTP requests need careful configuration of URLs, headers, JSON bodies, and mapped fields, and webhook testing adds extra steps. The AI Agent feature is promising but frustratingly slow and needs substantial direction. I would recommend more investment in the AI agent to make building automations faster and easier. [...] I like using Albato because there is no time wasted when it comes to getting support. I am not tech savvy so setting up basic things can be overwhelming. It doesnt matter how simple the question is you have just ask it. Send screenshots all the way through .. They have your back. I am very pleased with the support I got from an agent named Gospel. I had issues integrating and rather than stress out I use the live chat and he helped me with the entire process and even set things up himself to help me speed up the automation. I told him to leave the case open and we continued it the following day . That is the kind of support I like to leave reviews for. He solved everything . This is not the only time he has either. I had problems with using Albato for the first time and he helped with [...] ## The best support I have ever received
For almost a year I was unable to effectively track my ads campaigns in Meta, since my website used some booking engine and payment was done in Stripe window. This didn't allow Meta Pixel to track customers who actually made a booking.   
  
I almost felt like giving up, but then Meta support suggested to try Albato.   
  
I did try to set Automation myself, but could not configure it correctly. Again, almost gave up but decided to give it another shot and wrote to the support.   
  
Then the magic started. Pedro took exceptional care of me and helped to set up all flows correctly. Actually exceptional does not even describe it fully. The best, the most caring and amazing support I have ever received.
